column1: # TiDB parser "rest" corpus: the statements in pingcap's own parser tests that
# the single-statement pingcap_parser_corpus.tsv did not already carry, with the
# verdict omni/tidb/parser and TiDB v8.5.5 each give each one.
# Where pingcap_parser_corpus.tsv is forms tested one at a time, these are forms
# combined the way people write them: the ast restore tests parse a fragment
# inside a full statement template, so one row is a function inside a SELECT, a
# reference option inside a CREATE TABLE, a partition bound inside an ALTER.
#   omni    accept | reject -- what tidb/parser.Parse does with the statement
#   engine  accept | reject -- whether TiDB v8.5.5 accepts the syntax, via the
#   sql     the statement, verbatim, one line
# A gap is a row with omni reject and engine accept; an over-acceptance is the
# reverse and is a bug. Column 2 is measured, never hand-edited: see README.md.
# Provenance: extracted from github.com/pingcap/tidb at tag v8.5.5
#   - parser_test.go: the src of every []testCase / []testErrMsgCase element.
#                     for every NodeRestoreTestCase the call parses.
# Deduplicated against each other and against pingcap_parser_corpus.tsv. Only
# single-line statements are kept; 30 statements with an embedded newline or tab
# (multi-statement BEGIN/COMMIT scripts, LOAD DATA line terminators, base64
# BINLOG, set/enum members with a tab) are excluded, as the first corpus
# excludes them, because this format is one statement per line. See README.md.
